In mathematics, the [[Lagrangian system|Lagrangian theory]] on [[fiber bundle]]s is globally formulated in algebraic terms of the '''variational bicomplex''', without appealing to the [[calculus of variations]]. For instance, this is the case of  [[classical field theory]] on fiber bundles ([[covariant classical field theory]]).

The variational bicomplex is a [[cochain complex]] of the [[differential graded algebra]] of [[differential form|exterior forms]] on [[jet bundle|jet manifolds]] of sections of a fiber bundle. [[Lagrangian system|Lagrangian]]s and [[Lagrangian system|Euler–Lagrange operators]] on a fiber bundle are defined as elements of this bicomplex. [[Cohomology]] of the variational bicomplex leads to the global first variational formula and first [[Noether's theorem]].

Extended to Lagrangian theory of even and odd fields on [[graded manifold]]s, the variational bicomplex provides strict mathematical formulation of classical field theory in a general case of reducible degenerate Lagrangians and the Lagrangian [[BRST formalism|BRST theory]].
